# About #

Pycroft is the current user management system of the AG DSN student
network.  It is based on [Flask](https://flask.palletsprojects.com/) and expects a
[Postgres](https://www.postgresql.org/) database making use of the
[SQLAlchemy ORM](https://www.sqlalchemy.org/).

# Documentation #
The sphinx documentation can be found at https://agdsn.github.io/pycroft/.
It contains a [setup guide](https://agdsn.github.io/pycroft/guides/setup.html).

1: """
2: This package provides a standalone LDAP syncer.  For more information
3: on how to execute it, run ``python -m ldap_sync --help``.
4: 
5: The process is separated into the following steps:
6: 
7: 1. Fetch the users/groups/properties we want to sync from the database
8:    (:mod:`ldap_sync.sources.db`)
9: 2. Fetch the current users/groups/properties from the ldap (:mod:`ldap_sync.sources.ldap`)
10: 3. Create a diff (:mod:`ldap_sync.diff_records`)
11: 4. Execute the actions (:mod:`ldap_sync.execution`)
12: """
